products.product_description: Pumpkin Tree Peter Rabbit Organics Banana & Strawberry fruit puree, 4oz/113g pouch, UPC 815367010780, PTO Item 10720. Distributed by: PT Organics Ltd, 333 South State St, Suite V-142, Lake Oswego, OR 97034. Product is pasteurized blend of banana and strawberry purees sold in single serve spouted flexible film pouch (4oz/113g) with red cap. It is intended for consumption by children aged +6 months. Each master case contains 10/4oz. pouches of PT Organics Banana Strawberry 1006034. The bar code on master case label is 00815367010797.
